{
  "componentSlugs": ["dialog", "button"],
  "apiReferences": [
    { "component": "dialog", "property": "open" },
    { "component": "dialog", "property": "onOpenChange" },
    { "component": "dialog", "property": "closeOnOverlayClick", "value": "false" },
    { "component": "dialog", "property": "DialogBody children" },
    { "component": "dialog", "property": "DialogFooter children" },
    { "component": "dialog", "property": "finalFocusRef" },
    { "component": "button", "property": "variant", "value": "danger" },
    { "component": "button", "property": "variant", "value": "secondary" }
  ],
  "installCommands": ["npx shadcn add @skrewww/button"],
  "maturityClaims": [
    { "component": "dialog", "status": "stable" },
    { "component": "button", "status": "stable" }
  ],
  "shapeMode": "rounded",
  "surfaceMode": "glass",
  "skrewwwRegistryConfigured": true,
  "recipeIdsUsed": ["destructive-confirmation"],
  "accessibilityFacts": [
    "Dialog is the confirmation surface (role=\"dialog\", aria-modal); do not substitute Toast/Alert for a modal decision.",
    "Dialog traps focus while open, supports Escape-to-close, and restores focus to the trigger or finalFocusRef on close.",
    "Footer action hierarchy: secondary cancel/dismiss vs danger confirm; do not rely on color alone — danger variant plus clear action text.",
    "Button renders as a real <button> with keyboard activation (Tab/Enter/Space)."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Consumer layout confirms data-skrewww-shape=\"rounded\" and data-skrewww-surface=\"glass\"; preserve those modes.",
    "Button is installable via @skrewww; Dialog is implemented/stable but not installableViaSkrewwwRegistry, so no Dialog install command is suggested.",
    "closeOnOverlayClick is set false for a costly destructive delete to reduce accidental dismiss."
  ],
  "unresolvedGaps": [
    "Dialog is not currently distributed through the @skrewww registry (installableViaSkrewwwRegistry: false); consumer must obtain Dialog outside npx shadcn add @skrewww/dialog."
  ],
  "implementation": "Client page with a delete trigger Button and controlled Dialog (open/onOpenChange, closeOnOverlayClick={false}, finalFocusRef to the trigger). DialogBody holds consequence copy (heading + text as ordinary children). DialogFooter holds Button variant=\"secondary\" Cancel (closes via onOpenChange(false)) and Button variant=\"danger\" Delete/confirm. Install Button with `npx shadcn add @skrewww/button`; reuse or otherwise supply Dialog since it is not registry-installable. Preserve document Shape/Surface from layout."
}
